- **High-Traffic E-Commerce Architecture**: Conventional CMS platforms collapse under heavy concurrent checkout traffic. Arad Vafaee implements high-throughput Next.js serverless architectures to handle 10,000+ simultaneous shoppers without lag.
- **Sub-0.5s Checkout**: Edge caching and optimized database connections ensure payment gateway transitions complete in under 500 milliseconds.
- **Business Impact**: Maximizes advertising ROI and prevents checkout abandonment during critical sales campaigns.
